race.comment: ROB THE BANK (8) gets his chance after finishing fourth at this track over 1350m, beaten just over a length as favourite, with an awkward start and late bumps adding context. His previous second at Naracoorte was only a head defeat, and the return to 1200m is backed by two wins and two placings from six starts at this track and distance. ALL SHOT (2) steps into harder company off a Bordertown third, beaten just under a length as favourite, and his prior Morphettville fourth had merit after he jumped awkwardly and charged home. GREATESTOFEASE (14) was at long odds first-up at Gawler but was beaten just over three lengths and finished off better than eighth reads; the quick back-up, 3kg claim and time-rating profile keep her in calculations. SAHHA SWEETIE (9) has to come through mixed recent form, but her last-start sixth here came after racing wide and suffering interference, and her 1200m record puts her in the mix, along with FASHIZLEMANIZLE (4) and COSMIC INTERLUDE (7).
